description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the video color correction operation AdjustVideoColor
description_zh: 本文介绍视频校色AdjustVideoColor的语法及示例
name: AdjustVideoColor

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The bitrate of the output video. Unit: Mbit/s. Default value: 20. Valid values: 8 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频码率，单位为M，默认20M，取值范围`[8,200]`
parameters.name: video_bitrate

parameters.help_en: The encoding format of the output video. Valid values: h264, hevc, and prores. Default value: h264
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频编码格式，可选h264、hevc、prores三种。默认值为h264
parameters.name: video_codec

parameters.help_en: The format of the output video. Valid values: mp4 and mov. Default value: mp4
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频格式，可选mp4、mov两种。默认值为mp4
parameters.name: video_format

parameters.help_en: The color correction mode. Default value: LogC. For more information, see the color correction mode description
parameters.help_zh: 指定调色模式，默认值为LogC。具体请参见调色模式说明
parameters.name: mode

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the color-corrected video.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL is no longer accessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoUrl.description_zh:
调色后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
